ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OB$ is a ray inside $\angle AOC$, $OM$ is a ray inside $\angle AOB$, and $ON$ is a ray inside $\angle BOC$. As shown in Figure 1, $OM$ and $ON$ are the angle bisectors of $\angle AOB$ and $\angle BOC$, respectively. Given that $\angle AOB=30^\circ$ and $\angle MON=70^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $OM$ is the bisector of $\angle AOB$ and $\angle AOB=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOM=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB=15^\circ$,\\
Given that $\angle MON=70^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BON=\angle MON-\angle BOM=55^\circ$,\\
Since $ON$ is the bisector of $\angle BOC$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOC=2\angle BON=\boxed{110^\circ}$.
